meta.name: entra-agent-id
meta.description: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) including the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar. USE FOR: Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth, fmi_path token exchange, agent OBO, Workload Identity Federation for agents, polyglot agent auth, Microsoft.Identity.Web.AgentIdentities. DO NOT USE FOR: standard Entra app registration (use entra-app-registration), Microsoft Foundry agent authoring (use microsoft-foundry).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动化配置 Microsoft Entra 身份蓝图和令牌交换
copy.tagline_en: Automate Microsoft Entra identity blueprint provisioning and token exchange
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identities and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange

howto.what: Claude 会通过 Microsoft Graph 为 AI 代理创建并管理身份：新建 Agent Identity Blueprint、BlueprintPrincipal 和每个代理实例的 Agent Identity，并配置 OAuth 2.0 令牌交换（fmi_path、OBO、跨租户）及 AgentID sidecar 容器。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 AI 代理创建 Entra 身份蓝图（Blueprint、BlueprintPrincipal、Agent Identity），或配置代理的 OAuth 2.0/fmi_path/跨租户令牌交换时触发。不用于标准应用注册和 Microsoft Foundry 代理创作。

say.text: 配置 fmi_path 令牌交换，目标指向代理身份的主租户。
say.note: 会生成两段式交换的请求。

howto.what_en: Claude will create and manage identities for AI agents via Microsoft Graph: provision Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) plus the AgentID sidecar container.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to provision Entra identities for AI agents (Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, Agent Identity) or configure OAuth 2.0/fmi_path/cross-tenant token exchange. Not for standard app registration or Foundry authoring.

say_en.text: Create an Agent Identity Blueprint and its BlueprintPrincipal.
say_en.note: Calls Graph API to create blueprint and principal.

say_en.text: Create an Agent Identity for my Python agent and grant User.Read.All.
say_en.note: Creates identity and assigns app permission.

say_en.text: Configure fmi_path token exchange targeting the Agent Identity's home tenant.
